boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Seton Hall University
boards.description: Late-open campus destinations documented on Seton Hall’s public building schedule. Check access requirements before heading out.

cards.title: University Center
cards.subtitle: Bishop Dougherty University Center, South Orange campus
cards.notes: Use the University Center as a late campus stop, but bring your Seton Hall ID: the schedule says after-hours access is restricted.
cards.short_summary: A campus destination listed open until 1 a.m. on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall’s campus building schedule lists the University Center open from 7 a.m. to 1 a.m. Monday through Friday.
cards.source_title: Campus Building Schedule | Seton Hall University
cards.access_notes: Listed Monday–Friday hours: 7 a.m.–1 a.m. After-hours entry is restricted and requires a valid Seton Hall ID with authorized access.

cards.title: Walsh Library
cards.subtitle: South Orange campus
cards.notes: Plan a library stop before midnight and confirm the day’s services when you arrive; after-hours building access requires authorized Seton Hall ID.
cards.short_summary: A library destination listed open until midnight on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall’s campus building schedule lists Walsh Library open from 8 a.m. to 12 a.m. Monday through Friday.
cards.source_title: Campus Building Schedule | Seton Hall University
cards.access_notes: Listed Monday–Friday hours: 8 a.m.–12 a.m. After-hours entry is restricted and requires a valid Seton Hall ID with authorized access.
